contract_clauses: GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-1: JournalWriterQueue::flush_batch must enforce a per-flush encoded-byte budget before any owned_batch.commit() call, returning Err(JournalError::JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted, limit }) when the next staged event would push the accumulated bytes above the configured limit

GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-2: byte accounting basis is the full encoded record length (encode_record output), matching JournalWriteBatch::append_event and the existing parity test accounting_uses_full_encoded_length_not_payload_length

GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-3: byte-budget check fires AFTER the staged_keys duplicate guard and BEFORE owned_batch.insert; on rejection no partial prefix is staged or committed (master §49 Crash-Consistency Rule)

GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-4: drained = N (events that fit), written = N, queue retains the rejected event plus any not-yet-staged events so the next flush_batch may re-attempt after the caller drops the oversize event
GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-5: enqueue_journaled and enqueue_strict do NOT enforce the byte budget; only flush_batch does (matches bead text 'per group commit')
GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-6: checked_add(u64) overflow on the accumulator returns Err(JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted: u64::MAX, limit }) — no panic, no truncation

GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-7: StorageLimits grows a max_journal_batch_bytes field defaulting to 1_048_576 (DEFAULT_JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTE_LIMIT) so existing callers (vb_cli::ipc_serve, RuntimeJournalConfig::shared_journal, all workspace_tests) keep their current behavior with zero source edits

GROUP-COMMIT-BYTE-GATE-8: the queue-side byte gate must emit the SAME JournalError variant (JournalBatchBytesExceeded) and SAME diagnostic code (JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTES_EXCEEDED = 0x4022) as JournalWriteBatch::append_event, eliminating any parallel QueuedBatchBytesExceeded variant
open_questions: Enforce at enqueue or at flush_batch? Recommend flush_batch per bead text.
What byte-size basis? Recommend full encoded record length to match JournalWriteBatch path.
StorageLimits field name: max_journal_batch_bytes recommended (matches vb_core bridge).
Per-event size caching vs re-encode during flush? Recommend re-encode (memory-neutral).
RuntimeError classification of JournalBatchBytesExceeded — verify before claiming wire path is honest.

Existing error variant JournalBatchBytesExceeded { attempted: u64, limit: u64 } and diagnostic code 0x4022 / JOURNAL_BATCH_BYTES_EXCEEDED are reused as-is for the queued path; no new variant required.

Per-flush staging helper. encode_record at lines 61-67 returns the full encoded record whose .len() is the canonical byte-size basis (matches JournalWriteBatch parity test accounting_uses_full_encoded_length_not_payload_length).

Pure decision predicates shared by JournalWriterQueue and the (absent) Verus route. StorageQueueDecisionState (line 18) may need byte_budget and accumulated_bytes fields if proof-planner extends the Verus spec to cover the new byte gate.
